newsitem.title: USA: Arco to replace SPR oil within two weeks.
newsitem.headline: Arco to replace SPR oil within two weeks.

text.p: Arco Pipeline said Tuesday it will replace within two weeks a supply of crude it leased from government reserves near Freeport, Texas, last spring.

In May, the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) agreed to lease Arco up to one million barrels of crude from its Bryan Mound Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR) near Freeport to help feed the company's Seaway Pipeline after a line clogged.
The system runs from Freeport to Cushing, Oklahoma.
Arco said it paid DOE a lease fee and agreed to replace the oil within six months.
"The physical return is waiting for some storage space to be available," in SPR said John Thom, spokesman for Arco Pipeline.
He said Arco will delivery 902,000 barrels of Brent crude to the reserve.
Arco and Phillips Petroleum Co. own Seaway Pipeline.
